result.text:
I added all three features to the survey crawler in the image. All 51 tests in `SurveyCrawlerTest` pass: the 16 existing tests (updated for the new constructor) and 35 new ones. I haven't saved the image; tell me if you want me to.

## Design (category `SurveyCrawler`)
- **Commands:** each character becomes a command object: `CrawlerAdvanceCommand` (`a`), `CrawlerRetreatCommand` (`t`), `CrawlerTurnClockwiseCommand` (`h`), `CrawlerTurnCounterClockwiseCommand` (`g`), `CrawlerRepetitionCommand` (a digit), `CrawlerGuardedRunStartCommand` (`(`) and `CrawlerGuardedRunEndCommand` (`)`). A character with no command is an invalid command. `CrawlerNoCommand` stands in for "no previous command".
- **Repetition:** a digit tells the previous command to repeat itself digit + 2 more times. Only the four movement commands can repeat; any other previous command raises an invalid-repetition error.
- **Sonar and ground:** the crawler is now created with `SurveyCrawler at:facing:sensingWith:`, and asks its sonar `groundAt:`. The ground types handle movement and turning themselves:
  - `FirmSandGround` works as before.
  - `BoulderGround` raises an error and nothing changes.
  - `SiltGround` slides `nextInteger: 10` cells in the direction of travel (backwards when retreating) and doesn't affect turning. Its random generator is passed in so tests can control it.
- **Guarded runs:** the crawler is always in a `CrawlerFreeRun` or a `CrawlerGuardedRun`.
  - A guarded run records every movement. If any error occurs inside it, it undoes them in reverse order, switches back to a free run and passes the exception on.
  - It also raises an error on silt, on a nested `(` and when the sequence ends without `)`.
  - A free run raises an error on a `)` that has no matching `(`.
- **Facings:** each facing now gives a `forwardDirection`; this replaces the old `moveUp`/`moveDown`/`moveLeft`/`moveRight` double dispatch.
- **Error messages:** all are class methods on `SurveyCrawler`. I moved `invalidCommandErrorDescription` there from the instance side.

## Decisions the spec left open
- A digit at the start, after another digit, or after `(` or `)` is invalid (so `'a00'` fails after doing `a0`).
- Undoing a movement doesn't check the sonar. The crawler already crossed those cells, and checking would make it slide if it started on silt.
- If a guarded run fails, the one before it that finished is kept (`'(a)(aa)'` with a boulder ends at `1@3`).
- After a failed guarded run the crawler can start a new one.
- Outside a guarded run, movements made before an error are kept, as in the previous version.

## Tests (category `SurveyCrawler-Tests`)
I moved `SurveyCrawlerTest` into this category. Two test helpers live here too:
- **`SonarSimulator`:** you give it a map of position to ground; every other position is firm sand.
- **`LimitAnsweringRandom`:** always returns the maximum, so a silt slide is always 10 cells.

The new tests cover every example in the spec plus the edge cases above. One test uses a real `Random` and checks that the crawler lands anywhere from `1@3` to `1@12`.
